row.evidence: Sprinklr's developer portal documents SCIM (User) APIs to create, read, update and delete/disable users at /api/v2/scim/Users; Sprinklr publishes no prices and routes buyers to 'Get Pricing & Personalized Demo'.
row.notes: Quote-only: sprinklr.com/pricing/ returns 404 and the site offers only 'Get Pricing & Personalized Demo'. SCIM 2.0-style Users API (no Groups endpoint) on api3.sprinklr.com/{env}/api/v2/scim/Users, but every call needs a Sprinklr OAuth 2.0 bearer token plus an api-key header from a developer app, and only one token can exist per API key, so standard IdP SCIM clients are not documented as supported. Okta OIN app is SAML only and Microsoft's Entra tutorial is SSO only and says to provision with Sprinklr's own tools or APIs. SAML SSO (set up via support) can auto-provision users on first login. The non-SCIM 'User APIs' (/api/v2/scim/{userId}) and an Audit API also exist. Default API limits: 1000 requests/hour and 10/second per key.

auth.token_source: Sprinklr developer app API key + OAuth 2.0 access token (code grant or client credentials); user needs the Generate Token permission

deprovision.notes: DELETE /Users/{userId} deletes/deprovisions; the overview also describes disabling, and PATCH can set active status.

custom.how: Sprinklr extensions urn:scim:schemas:extension:sprinklrGlobalAttributes:2.0:User (partnerCustomProperties, productSeat, federationId, passwordLoginDisabled) and sprinklrClientAttributes:2.0:User (clientId, userType, phoneNumbers, clientCustomProperties, businessCategory, designation, department, managerId, persona, personaViewEnabled, personaApp, userGroupIds, primaryUserGroupId); isSpaceUser.

roles.how: clientAttributes.userType (PARTNER_ADMIN, PARTNER_USER, CLIENT_ADMIN, CLIENT_USER), persona, userGroupIds; globalAttributes.productSeat assigns the product seat.

rate_limits.text: Default 1000 requests per hour and 10 requests per second per API key.

limitations.text: Calls need an OAuth bearer token plus a Sprinklr api-key header, and only one token can exist per API key; Okta's and Entra's catalogue apps do not provision.
No SCIM Groups endpoint is documented; group membership is set through the userGroupIds attribute.
Search filters can only be combined with 'and'.

endpoints.purpose: Audit API V1 (change history of assets)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit API covers asset classes (cases, messages, profiles, media, outbound messages), not user/admin events.

rate_limits.text: Default 1000 requests per hour and 10 requests per second per API key.

okta.notes: OIN functionality ticks SAML only; no SCIM or provisioning ticks.
